sources.title: DAOS transaction model
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: DAOS transaction：衝突重試與餘額不變量
related.titleEn: DAOS transactions: conflict retries and balance invariants
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付版本圖、視圖解析器、去重容量、候選回收表與一個仍被快照保護的反例；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the version graph, view resolver, deduplicated capacity and reclamation candidates, plus a version still protected by a snapshot. Explain the boundary between logical accounting and observed physical reclamation. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 事件表包含 transaction_id、read_version、requested_debit、commit_status 與 balance_after；另保留已完成冪等鍵集合。
related.differenceEn: Record transaction identity, read version, requested debit, commit status and balance after each event. Maintain a separate set of completed idempotency keys so retried delivery cannot apply one debit twice.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每個保留視圖對每個鍵選不晚於 epoch 的最新版本，再對版本識別碼取聯集計容量；沒有引用的版本才是此模型候選；單鍵三版本：epoch 1 為 4 MiB、epoch 2 為 8、epoch 3 為 4；名義保留快照 1、2 與最新 3，變更移除快照 1；名義式 4+8+4 = 16 MiB referenced；變更式 8+4 = 12 MiB referenced。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

帳本規則為餘額不可負，交易需基於當前版本提交；衝突後須重讀再判斷，不可直接重送舊計算結果；初始 100 單位；第一交易扣 60。名義第二交易也要求 60，應拒絕；變更第二要求 30，重讀後可提交；名義式 100-60 = 40 balance units；變更式 100-60-30 = 10 balance units。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For each retained view and key, select the latest version not newer than its epoch. Sum the union of referenced version identities; unreferenced versions are reclamation candidates only within this simplified model. One key has versions of 4 MiB at epoch 1, 8 MiB at epoch 2 and 4 MiB at epoch 3. Retain snapshots 1 and 2 plus latest view 3, then remove snapshot 1 only. Nominal 4+8+4 = 16 MiB referenced; changed 8+4 = 12 MiB referenced. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Require nonnegative balance and submission against the current version. After conflict, reread and reevaluate the business rule rather than resubmitting a value calculated from a stale snapshot. Start with 100 units and commit a first debit of 60. A second debit requests 60 nominally and must be rejected after reread; changing that request to 30 allows a valid subsequent commit. Nominal 100-60 = 40 balance units; changed 100-60-30 = 10 balance units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 液冷 thermal ride-through：蓄熱量與反應時間
related.titleEn: Liquid-cooling thermal ride-through: stored heat and response time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付版本圖、視圖解析器、去重容量、候選回收表與一個仍被快照保護的反例；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the version graph, view resolver, deduplicated capacity and reclamation candidates, plus a version still protected by a snapshot. Explain the boundary between logical accounting and observed physical reclamation. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 temperature、time、net_heat 與 capacitance 表，標記初始溫度和上限；不得把機房空氣與冷卻液溫度當同一狀態。
related.differenceEn: Build temperature, time, net heat and capacitance records, labeling the initial temperature and limit. Do not treat room air and coolant temperatures as one interchangeable state without a justified coupled model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每個保留視圖對每個鍵選不晚於 epoch 的最新版本，再對版本識別碼取聯集計容量；沒有引用的版本才是此模型候選；單鍵三版本：epoch 1 為 4 MiB、epoch 2 為 8、epoch 3 為 4；名義保留快照 1、2 與最新 3，變更移除快照 1；名義式 4+8+4 = 16 MiB referenced；變更式 8+4 = 12 MiB referenced。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

固定淨熱功率下 C*dT/dt=P，達容許溫升 ΔT 的時間為 CΔT/P；C 需為熱容量，不是比熱；有效熱容量 500 kJ/K，容許升溫 8 K；淨熱量由 100 增為 200 kW，冷卻移除已從 P 扣除；名義式 500*8/100 = 40 s to modeled limit；變更式 500*8/200 = 20 s to modeled limit。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For each retained view and key, select the latest version not newer than its epoch. Sum the union of referenced version identities; unreferenced versions are reclamation candidates only within this simplified model. One key has versions of 4 MiB at epoch 1, 8 MiB at epoch 2 and 4 MiB at epoch 3. Retain snapshots 1 and 2 plus latest view 3, then remove snapshot 1 only. Nominal 4+8+4 = 16 MiB referenced; changed 8+4 = 12 MiB referenced. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Under constant net heat input, C*dT/dt=P, so time to allowed rise ΔT is CΔT/P. C is total thermal capacitance, not specific heat, and the model assumes a uniformly represented temperature. Set effective capacitance to 500 kJ/K and allowable temperature rise to 8 K. Net heat input changes from 100 to 200 kW, with any remaining heat removal already subtracted from P. Nominal 500*8/100 = 40 s to modeled limit; changed 500*8/200 = 20 s to modeled limit. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
